title: Connect's runtime configuration is one powerhouse.config.json fetched once at boot — a hand-edited source and a built dist — and the SPA never reads environment variables
content:
The file exists twice: a hand-edited **source** in the project root (next to `package.json`, also carrying keys other tooling reads — `studio.port`, `reactor.*`, `auth.*`, `documentModelsDir`) and a built **dist** that Connect serves. `apps/connect/main.tsx` fetches `/powerhouse.config.json` once, `ConfigLoader` caches it, and the SPA reads typed accessors (`getRuntimeConfig()` / `getConnectConfig()`). Top-level fields (`packages`, `packageRegistryUrl`, `localPackage`) are project-wide; the `connect.*` block (branding, app, renown, drives, packages, sentry, reactor, pwa) is Connect-only, with defaults defined once as `DEFAULT_CONNECT_CONFIG` in `packages/shared/connect/runtime-config.ts`.

`ph connect build` produces the dist file by deep-merging lowest → highest:

```
DEFAULT_CONNECT_CONFIG  <  source.connect  <  CLI flag overrides
```

Each layer may supply a partial value; missing leaves fall back to the layer below; **arrays replace** (never append); `undefined` in a patch means "leave alone". Five ways feed a value in: the `ph init` template, a manual edit, `ph connect config` (**dual-writes** source and dist so the change lands on the next refresh without a rebuild — four mutually exclusive modes: list, `--get`, set with Ajv validation and JSON-aware coercion, `--json` bulk), `ph connect build --<field>` (dist only; the four `commonArgs` flags are gated through `wasFlagExplicitlyPassed` so an untyped flag lets the source value win), and the Docker entrypoint's `PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON` at container start (operator-wins). `ph install --registry <url>` and `ph vetra`'s programmatic `callerOverride` are the two special-case writers.

A hard refresh tears down the module graph and re-runs `loadRuntimeConfig()`, so an operator's path is: write the value (`ph connect config --renown-url X`), refresh the tab. `ph connect config` with no args prints the effective `connect.*` block without booting Connect.

_Source: apps/connect/RUNTIME-CONFIG.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.74)._
